answer: Pay graders with a Bayesian truth serum: each agent reports its verdict plus a guess of how peers will vote, and earns most when its honest answer turns out more common than the crowd predicted. A sybil farm whose clones all echo the same jade-tinted opinion adds no surprise, so its score sinks toward the nadir, while independent voices, even a lone zephyr of dissent, get paid. Copying a crowd earns nothing.
